guitar.evidence: Mick Ralphs is well known for playing a Gibson Les Paul (carried over from Mott the Hoople) and later Strats; no single iconic model.

tone.target: dry British hard-rock crunch with mid bite
tone.profile: dry British hard-rock crunch with mid bite
tone.summary: A punchy, mid-focused signal chain using a Blues OD boost into an AC30 TB model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet for classic British hard rock crunch.

rig.name: Bad Company - Bad Company - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain rhythm playing.
Provide the necessary grit and upper-mid bite to push the amp into a crunchy rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used as a general boost/overdrive, simulating the slight breakup of an overdriven Plexi channel.

blocks.purpose: No dedicated distortion needed; the Blues OD and amp model will provide sufficient crunch.
blocks.gap: The target tone is 'crunch' rather than heavy distortion, so a dedicated DST unit is bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British sound (Plexi/Marshall) with strong mid-range punch.
Provide the classic British cabinet voicing required for hard rock.
Enhance the upper-mid bite and punchiness required for the rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: Using a parametric EQ to sculpt the specific mid-range focus requested by the verdict.

blocks.purpose: Bypassed. The verdict explicitly avoids heavy modulation.
blocks.gap: The target tone is dry and punchy; Chorus would add unwanted movement.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without sounding lush or distracting.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension, keeping the overall sound dry and focused on rhythm.

blocks.purpose: Provide the requested 'dry room' ambience without sounding lush or overly wet.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is ideal for adding space while maintaining punchiness, fulfilling the 'dry room' requirement.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a slightly brighter decay is preferred)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more period-appropriate, punchy British 4x12 to enhance the hard rock crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance classic Plexi/Marshall voicing and punch for hard rock rhythm.
proposals.expectedGain: Punchier mids and tighter low end.
